name: street-light-management-system
description: Smart Street Light Management System IoT Industrial Platform with HiveMQ CE, PostgreSQL 15, Node.js Backend, Simulator, and React Dashboard.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --prefix "[{name}]" --names "BACKEND,SIMULATOR,DASHBOARD" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:simulator" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix simulator install && npm --prefix dashboard install && npm install
